name: Artillerist (Marshal Archetype)
body:
Subpages

Artillerists provide long range support and lead from the back, ensuring victory by striking at the right moment.

Hit Die: d8

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

An artillerist is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields (but not tower shields).

Spellcasting

An artillerist casts spells as a sorcerer, they learn evocation spells drawn from a combination of the sorcerer/wizard and bard spell lists. If a spell appears on both lists treat it as the lower of the two spell levels.

Artillerists can cast only a limited number of spells per day as shown on the table below. The artillerist uses their Charisma modifier to determine their bonus spells per day and their spell save DC.

This ability replaces the auras normally gained by the marshal as well as all aura bonus and vital inspiration abilities.

Distant Inspiration (Ex)

Artillerists often need to be heard at greater distance than most marshals. At 4th level, the distance at which they can use inspire action increases to 100 feet. This distance increases again at 13th level to 150 feet.

This ability replaces twin aura and the tactical adjustment gained at 13th level.

Distant Tactics (Ex)

At 8th level, when using their tactician ability artillerists can grant their teamwork feats to more distant allies. Rather than affecting allies within 30 feet, an artillerist may choose to affect a number of allies within 100 feet equal to their Charisma modifier.

This ability replaces the teamwork feat gained at 8th level.

Advanced Learning (Ex)

Artillerists know that study builds better soldiers. At 11th and again at 19th level, an artillerist can add 3 spells to their spell list from the sorcerer/wizard or bard spell lists. These spells can be of any school but must be medium or long range spells of levels the artillerist can cast. If a spell appears on both lists use the lower of the two spell levels to determine the spell level for the artillerist.

This ability replaces triple and quadruple aura.

Artillerize Spell (Su)

The artillerist is often looking to expand the range of their spells to provide better support. At 9th level, an artillerist may double the range of any targeted evocation spell they cast without increasing its level or casting time twice per day. At 17th level, they may use this ability an additional number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier.

This ability replaces the tactical adjustment gained at 9th and 17th level.
